top_signals.title: US escalates Iran pressure with sanctions on crypto, aviation, shipping and gold as part of ‘economic D-Day’
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department is zeroing in on digital assets it says are being used to bolster Iran’s economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India’s New Stock Auction System Faces First Monthly Expiry Test
top_signals.summary: Indian traders are bracing for their first monthly derivatives expiry using auction-based end-of-day stock prices, a crucial test for a mechanism that has faced backlash over sharp swings and allegations of manipulation.
